{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low during uptrends - use 50-80% of true price displacement from model base level",
    "When sentiment is positive (0.33+), increase forecast by 1-3 points to correct lag behind price momentum",
    "Negative sentiment (below 0) has minimal effect on prices - model over-corrects for this",
    "Mean reversion bias in model needs correction when prices are in clear uptrend (last 5 days up)",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive requires faster forecast ramp than sentiment improving within positive range",
    "Model levels are too high for declining markets - shave 2-4 points from 30-day flat base in downtrends",
    "Forecast curve should be flatter when sentiment is extremely negative (below -0.33) as price reacts slowly to favorable news"
] }
